## Status Quo

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

compute_group_post <- function(data, scales){
  
  data |>
    mutate(xend = x, yend = 0)
  
}

StatPost <- ggproto("StatPost", Stat, 
                    compute_group = compute_group_post,
                    required_aes = c("x", "y"))

geom_post <- make_constructor(GeomSegment, stat = StatPost)


library(ggplot2)

shot_fun <- function(x, v0 = 15, angle_deg = 30, g = 9.81, y0 = 1.7) {
  
  radians <- angle_deg * pi / 180
  
  y <- y0 + 
    x * tan(radians) - 
    (g * x ^ 2) / (2 * v0 ^ 2 * cos(radians) ^ 2)
  
  ifelse(y >= 0, y, 0)
  
}

{ggplot() +
  geom_post(aes(x = 0, y = 1.7)) + 
  geom_post(aes(x = 10, y = 3.5)) + 
  geom_spoke(aes(x = 0, y = 1.7, 
                 angle = pi*30/180, radius = 2), 
             arrow = arrow(type = "closed")) + 
  coord_equal() + 
  geom_function(fun = shot_fun, aes(color = "30°"))  + 
  geom_function(fun = shot_fun, aes(color = "20°"),
    args = list(v0 = 15, angle_deg = 20))  + 
  geom_function(fun = shot_fun, aes(color = "7°"),
    args = list(v0 = 7, angle_deg = 20)) } |>
  codehover::ch_hover()




```
